description: Retrieval eval for samples/corpus (generated by scripts/make_sample_corpus.py). A text question is a hit when a top-k text match comes from `file` and contains one of `answer` (case-, hyphen- and punctuation-insensitive; alternates cover Whisper writing numbers as digits). A visual question is a hit when a top-k visual match comes from `file`.
